Published Time: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 23:04:43 GMT La Traviata Pizzeria, New York - Menu, Reviews (241), Photos (46) - Restaurantji 101 W 68th St, New York (212) 721-1101 721-1101) La Traviata Pizzeria is a fantastic spot for slices in the Lincoln Square area. They offer a nice slice assortment each day, along with plenty of beverages to choose from. The service is quick and kind, and they offer delivery as well as some outdoor seating. Customers have praised the delicious pizza, with one reviewer ordering eight pies for a group of students and being very impressed with the prompt service and quality. Overall, La Traviata Pizzeria is a gem in the neighborhood, offering great pizza at reasonable prices.
